name: Après le considérant A – 1
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the 35th anniversary of the fall and destruction of Vukovar
part_text: Aa. whereas ethnically exclusionary rhetoric employed by political leaders across the region fuelled divisions, deepened mistrust and undermined prospects for peaceful coexistence, which resulted in incidents of violence against civilians of all ethnicities, including unlawful killings, even before the outbreak of armed conflict in Vukovar;
